title: Sandworm_Exaramel_Incident_Response_Scenario_67f
description: Investigate and respond to a Sandworm threat group compromise using the Exaramel backdoor malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the Sandworm threat group using the Exaramel backdoor malware. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and identify lateral movement to other hosts. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and identify lateral movement to other hosts. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the target host for suspicious services or processes that may indicate malware activity. What is the name of the suspicious service running on the target host? (The flag is the name of the service.)
levels.solution: The suspicious service is payload-transfer.service. This is the flag you were looking for.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services using the command `systemctl list-units --type=service --all` and look for anything unusual or unauthorized.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that involve file transfers or remote execution. The flag is the name of the suspicious service.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service maintains persistence on the target host. What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service? (The flag is the name of the timer.)
levels.solution: The persistence mechanism is payload-transfer.timer. This is the flag you were looking for.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd services and timers using the command `systemctl list-timers --all` for any unusual configurations.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that involve file transfers or remote execution. The flag is the name of the timer.

levels.title: Investigate Lateral Movement
levels.content: Investigate the lateral movement from the target host to another host in the network. What is the name of the service responsible for transferring data from the target host to another host? (The flag is the name of the script.)
levels.solution: The service responsible for lateral movement is payload-transfer.sh. This is the flag you were looking for.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that involve file transfers or remote execution using the command `ps aux | grep -i transfer`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check running services and look for anything unusual or unauthorized. The flag is the name of the script.
